messages:
tara: Quick triage: ran a small AB of reranker-v2 (PTQ int8) comparing our usual prefix priming vs a suffix-priming variant. Results split by corpus; ndcg improves on FAQ-style docs but MRR drops on transaction/support queries.

hugo: Can you paste the numbers and sample size?

tara: Holdout: 2026-05-02 (intent-stratified), n=4800, seed=21. Snapshot below.

mei: metrics table:

```
corpus     | arm        | ndcg@10 | mrr
-----------|------------|---------|-----
faq        | prefix     | 0.734   | 0.486
faq        | suffix     | 0.737   | 0.483
support    | prefix     | 0.659   | 0.401
support    | suffix     | 0.647   | 0.384
```

mei: Extra notes: suffix priming reduces token-merge at the query start (so fewer subword boundary changes) but seems to hurt support more. Token diffs show suffix sometimes pushes punctuation into candidate context for short queries.

hugo: Did you emit per-query token diffs and tie-rate? PTQ can amplify tiny deltas so tie flips matter.

tara: Yes. I included `--emit-token-diff` and `--emit-tie-rate`. For a failing support example, prefix produced tokenization: `[pre, re##set, pass]` while suffix kept `[reset, pass]` but score-gap distribution changed: pre-PTQ gap 5.8e-3 -> post-PTQ 2.1e-4, ordering flipped.

mei: Also tried `--strip-formatting` on candidates for a small sample; the support MRR loss shrank to within noise. So doc formatting is a big amplifier.

hugo: Actionable plan:
- Run full matrix (arms: prefix, suffix, no-priming) x formatting flag (strip vs raw) x PTQ seeds [5, 37] to estimate quant variance
- Add measurement-only deterministic fallback tie-breaker (ranker.tie_policy=doc_hash) to quantify tie flips without affecting score computation
- Compute per-slice effect matrix keyed by (corpus, query_len_bin, html_noise_bin) with columns ndcg_delta,mrr_delta,tie_rate_delta,score_gap_var
- Prototype a "non-joiner" sentinel (U+200C) between prefix and query to avoid merges and test it as a lightweight mitigation

tara: Commands I ran for initial snapshot:
```
./eval_rerank \
  --model models/reranker-v2-int8.ptq \
  --holdout s3://bench/holdouts/2026-05-02.json \
  --priming templates/prefix.json \
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --seed 21 --samples 4800 \
  --emit-token-diff --emit-tie-rate --out /tmp/7355550000_prefix.json
```

ops-bot: Job 7355550011 started: eval_rerank (arms=prefix,suffix,no-priming; samples=4800).

mei: Quick follow-ups I'll run tonight: 1) matrix with strip-formatting true, 2) PTQ re-cal with seed=37, 3) suffix+non-joiner experiment. I'll upload per-query delta histograms and tie-rate probes.

hugo: After artifacts, we'll compute a risk matrix and pick a rollout strategy: (A) enable suffix-priming only for FAQ routes, (B) enable prefix globally with upstream formatting strip, or (C) use a non-joiner sentinel + quant-recal. Prefer the minimal-change operational path that controls tie flips.

tara: Sounds good. tagging slices: "short-support", "faq-ambiguous", "html-heavy". Posting results when jobs finish. :hourglass:
